name: Can I prevent clogs, or do I always need professional help?

mainEntity.name: Can I prevent clogs, or do I always need professional help?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can significantly reduce the likelihood of clogs by being mindful of what goes down your drains. Avoid pouring grease or oil down sinks, use drain screens to catch hair and food particles, and dispose of non-flushable items in the trash. Regular flushing with hot water and baking soda can also help maintain drains. However, for deep-seated, persistent, or recurring clogs, professional drain cleaning is typically required to fully clear the blockage and prevent further issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent clogs by avoiding grease, using drain screens, and not flushing non-flushable items. For persistent or severe clogs, professional help is often needed.
